name: The Delegation Map
unit: one leader + team, or a peer circle of leads

flow.does: Every task the leader currently owns, one per note
Place each note in a zone; the leader speaks last
The single highest-leverage hand-off this week
One sentence per person about Monday

commitment: Support they get — an hour of coaching, a document, a decision right
Review date — and what “working” looks like then
debrief_prompts: Which column is fullest, and how did this plate get that way?
How many notes in Only me are accountability, and how many are habit?
Which note was uncomfortable to place in Anyone can run?
Why this hand-off and not the easier one next to it?
Did the owner agree, or were they assigned?
What will “working” look like on the review date?
watch_outs: Everything lands in Only me — the leader is protecting identity, not work.
Everything lands in Anyone can run — pull back the two notes carrying real accountability.
The circled hand-off has no named support — it is a dump; force one hour or one document.
note: No pre/post measure in this folder: the artifact is the point. Hand this spec to an agent to render a fillable sheet or a live form.
